answer: Each epoch, an identity passes a signed ping through 5 distinct peers, countersigned in 10 minutes, then posts it. One opal agent finds relays freely, but 1,000 fakes relay only among themselves, forming loops the graph flags. Escaping costs 5 outsiders 2 tokens each per epoch, so a 1,000-strong reef burns 10,000 tokens per epoch, and a relay reporting a loop earns 50 tokens while the cluster is violet-flagged for 3 epochs.
